scope: Independent bounded source peer of canonical Module shared lazy watch reporting and exact _load/_findPath bindings.
semantic_findings: Acquisition authenticates the exact canonical Module through loaderEnvironment/cachedOwner even when the watch graph is already cached. One private Engine graph holds the shared lazy value and process/path/captured map; no public Module or transport is installed.

The captured actual Array.prototype.map is added to the pre-guest constructor bootstrap. Watch acquisition itself performs no process.env read. Captured Map is called with the real extensions receiver, preserving length/Has/Get, holes, inherited elements, species and abrupt completion.

The lazy initialized flag is independent of value, so undefined is cached. Initializer failure leaves the flag unchanged; successful outer assignment replaces a completed reentrant inner value, while throwing outer initialization preserves completed inner state. Conversion to Boolean is confined to the two original conditions.

Both reporters preserve the first live process.send truthiness read and second live callee read, with process as receiver. The callee is selected before message argument construction. Filename identity is retained without coercion.

Message objects and the required-file array use actual own definitions, bypassing inherited setters and preserving ordinary prototypes/descriptors. For missing paths, the object exists before map, the mapper is nonconstructible, and path.resolve is looked up before separate base/ext ToString operations on each visited element.

Scope and callable roots retain state, callee, mapper and captured operands through guest getters, species constructors, coercion, send and reentry. Thrown map/send/initializer reasons propagate without resetting already-completed lazy state.

_load binds the actual shared reportModuleToWatchMode and retains its existing loadBody/control flow byte-for-byte. _findPath replaces only its external reporter input with the authenticated shared reportModuleNotFoundToWatchMode; all capture indexes and the old search algorithm are preserved.

All eleven controls were read. They exercise genuine Module/primordial/path owners and deliberate mutable guest env/send/path/array behavior. No production transport or full application qualification is claimed.
